CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.determiner_engine(lot1_id integer, lot2_id integer)
 RETURNS character varying
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    engine_name VARCHAR;
BEGIN
    IF lot1_id = 1 AND lot2_id = 2 THEN engine_name := 'train'; -- Train
    ELSIF lot1_id = 1 AND lot2_id = 3 THEN engine_name := 'car'; -- Car
    ELSIF lot1_id = 1 AND lot2_id = 4 THEN engine_name := 'bus'; -- Bus
    ELSIF lot1_id = 2 AND lot2_id = 3 THEN engine_name := 'helicoptere'; -- Helicoptere
    ELSIF lot1_id = 2 AND lot2_id = 4 THEN engine_name := 'ship'; -- Ship
    ELSIF lot1_id = 3 AND lot2_id = 4 THEN engine_name := 'plane'; -- Plane
    ELSIF lot1_id = 1 AND lot2_id = 1 THEN engine_name := 'ambulance'; -- Ambulance
    ELSIF lot1_id = 2 AND lot2_id = 2 THEN engine_name := 'pompier'; -- Pompier
    ELSIF lot1_id = 3 AND lot2_id = 3 THEN engine_name := 'bulldozer'; -- Bulldozer
    ELSIF lot1_id = 4 AND lot2_id = 4 THEN engine_name := 'titan'; -- Titan
    ELSE engine_name := NULL;
    END IF;
    RETURN engine_name;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_update_quartier()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    NEW.quartier := (
        SELECT cq.libelle 
        FROM combinaison_quartier cq
        WHERE 
            cq.quartier1 = trouver_quartier(NEW.num1) AND
            cq.quartier2 = trouver_quartier(NEW.num2)
    );
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_mundo_triangle_positions()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    updated_count INTEGER;
    missing_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- Mise à jour des positions
    UPDATE combinations c
    SET 
        ligne = t.ligne,
        colonne = t.colonne
    FROM 
        temp_mundo_triangle t
    WHERE 
        c.univers = 'mundo' AND
        c.forme = 'triangle' AND
        c.denomination = t.contenu AND
        t.contenu IS NOT NULL;
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
    
    -- Comptage des combinaisons non trouvées
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO missing_count
    FROM combinations
    WHERE 
        univers = 'mundo' AND 
        forme = 'triangle' AND 
        ligne IS NULL;
    
    RETURN 'Mise à jour terminée. ' || updated_count || ' combinaisons positionnées. ' || 
           missing_count || ' combinaisons sans correspondance.';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_combinations_for_ash16()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Mettre à jour les combinaisons pour ash16 avec exclusions
    UPDATE combinations
    SET univers_id = 1, -- mundo
        forme_id = (SELECT forme_id FROM formes WHERE forme_name = 'carre'),
        forme = 'carre'
    WHERE ash_num1 = '1' AND ash_num2 = '1'
      AND NOT ((room_num1 = 'room9' AND room_num2 = 'room9') OR (room_num1 = 'room13' AND room_num2 = 'room13'));

    -- Mettre à jour les combinaisons intra-room9 et intra-room13 pour ash16
    UPDATE combinations
    SET univers_id = 2, -- fruity
        forme_id = (SELECT forme_id FROM formes WHERE forme_name = 'carre'),
        forme = 'carre'
    WHERE ash_num1 = '1' AND ash_num2 = '1'
      AND ((room_num1 = 'room9' AND room_num2 = 'room9') OR (room_num1 = 'room13' AND room_num2 = 'room13'));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.determiner_engine(lot_num1 text, lot_num2 text, ash_num1 text, ash_num2 text, room_num1 text, room_num2 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Cas où room_num1 = room_num2 dans les groupes spécifiques
    IF room_num1 = room_num2 THEN
        RETURN CASE
            WHEN room_num1 IN ('room1', 'room2', 'room3', 'room4') THEN 'ambulance'
            WHEN room_num1 IN ('room5', 'room6', 'room7', 'room8') THEN 'pompier'
            WHEN room_num1 IN ('room9', 'room10', 'room11', 'room12') THEN 'bulldozer'
            WHEN room_num1 IN ('room13', 'room14', 'room15', 'room16') THEN 'titan'
            ELSE NULL
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Cas où lot_num1 = lot_num2 = lot1
    IF lot_num1 = 'lot1' AND lot_num2 = 'lot1' THEN
        RETURN CASE
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'train'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'car'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'bus'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'helicoptere'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'ship'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') THEN 'plane'
            ELSE NULL
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Cas où lot_num1 = lot_num2 = lot2
    IF lot_num1 = 'lot2' AND lot_num2 = 'lot2' THEN
        RETURN CASE
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'train'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'car'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'bus'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'helicoptere'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'ship'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') THEN 'plane'
            ELSE NULL
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Cas où lot_num1 = lot_num2 = lot3
    IF lot_num1 = 'lot3' AND lot_num2 = 'lot3' THEN
        RETURN CASE
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'train'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'car'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'bus'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'helicoptere'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'ship'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') THEN 'plane'
            ELSE NULL
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Cas où lot_num1 = lot_num2 = lot4
    IF lot_num1 = 'lot4' AND lot_num2 = 'lot4' THEN
        RETURN CASE
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'train'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'car'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash16' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash16') THEN 'bus'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'helicoptere'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash20' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash20') THEN 'ship'
            WHEN (ash_num1 = 'ash24' AND ash_num2 = 'ash30') OR (ash_num1 = 'ash30' AND ash_num2 = 'ash24') THEN 'plane'
            ELSE NULL
        END;
    END IF;

    -- Cas généraux pour les autres combinaisons de lots
    RETURN CASE
        WHEN (lot_num1 = 'lot1' AND lot_num2 = 'lot2') OR (lot_num1 = 'lot2' AND lot_num2 = 'lot1') THEN 'train'
        WHEN (lot_num1 = 'lot1' AND lot_num2 = 'lot3') OR (lot_num1 = 'lot3' AND lot_num2 = 'lot1') THEN 'car'
        WHEN (lot_num1 = 'lot1' AND lot_num2 = 'lot4') OR (lot_num1 = 'lot4' AND lot_num2 = 'lot1') THEN 'bus'
        WHEN (lot_num1 = 'lot2' AND lot_num2 = 'lot3') OR (lot_num1 = 'lot3' AND lot_num2 = 'lot2') THEN 'helicoptere'
        WHEN (lot_num1 = 'lot2' AND lot_num2 = 'lot4') OR (lot_num1 = 'lot4' AND lot_num2 = 'lot2') THEN 'ship'
        WHEN (lot_num1 = 'lot3' AND lot_num2 = 'lot4') OR (lot_num1 = 'lot4' AND lot_num2 = 'lot3') THEN 'plane'
        WHEN lot_num1 = 'lot1' AND lot_num2 = 'lot1' THEN 'ambulance'
        WHEN lot_num1 = 'lot2' AND lot_num2 = 'lot2' THEN 'pompier'
        WHEN lot_num1 = 'lot3' AND lot_num2 = 'lot3' THEN 'bulldozer'
        WHEN lot_num1 = 'lot4' AND lot_num2 = 'lot4' THEN 'titan'
        ELSE NULL
    END;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.determiner_univers_sunshine(col_num1 text, col_num2 text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Vérifier si col_num1 appartient à (col1, col2) et col_num2 appartient à (col3, col4, col5, col6) ou l'inverse
    IF (col_num1 IN ('col1', 'col2') AND col_num2 IN ('col3', 'col4', 'col5', 'col6')) OR
       (col_num2 IN ('col1', 'col2') AND col_num1 IN ('col3', 'col4', 'col5', 'col6')) THEN
        RETURN 'sunshine';
    ELSE
        RETURN NULL; -- Si les conditions ne sont pas remplies, retourne NULL
    END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_combinations_on_insert_or_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Mettre à jour les valeurs manquantes pour la ligne insérée ou mise à jour
    UPDATE combinations c
    SET ligne = u.ligne,
        colonne = u.colonne,
        chip = u.chip,
        chip_id = u.chip_id
    FROM chip_univers_formes u
    WHERE c.denomination = u.denomination
      AND c.univers = u.univers
      AND c.forme = u.forme
      AND (c.ligne IS NULL OR c.colonne IS NULL OR c.chip IS NULL OR c.chip_id IS NULL)
      AND c.combination_id = NEW.combination_id;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_tomes_all_univers_safe()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    univers_list TEXT[] := ARRAY['mundo', 'fruity', 'trigga', 'roaster', 'sunshine'];
    current_univers TEXT;
    processed_count INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
    FOREACH current_univers IN ARRAY univers_list LOOP
        BEGIN
            RAISE NOTICE 'Traitement de l''univers : %', current_univers;
            
            UPDATE combinations c
            SET tome = determine_tome((
                WITH chip_denominations AS (
                    SELECT 
                        c2.chip,
                        nd.full_name AS denomination,
                        MAX(get_granque_value(c2.granque_name)) AS granque_value,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT c2.combination_id) AS combination_count
                    FROM 
                        combinations c2
                        JOIN numbered_denominations nd ON c2.denomination_id = nd.denomination_id
                    WHERE 
                        c2.univers = c.univers
                        AND c2.chip = c.chip
                        AND c2.denomination_id IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY 
                        c2.chip, nd.full_name
                )
                SELECT 
                    (SUM(granque_value) + SUM(combination_count))::NUMERIC
                FROM 
                    chip_denominations
                WHERE chip = c.chip
            ))
            WHERE c.univers = current_univers
            AND c.denomination_id IS NOT NULL;
            
            GET DIAGNOSTICS processed_count = ROW_COUNT;
            RAISE NOTICE 'Univers % traité : % lignes mises à jour', current_univers, processed_count;
            
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            RAISE WARNING 'Erreur lors du traitement de l''univers % : %', current_univers, SQLERRM;
            -- Continuer avec l'univers suivant
        END;
    END LOOP;
    
    RAISE NOTICE 'Calcul terminé pour tous les univers';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_form(ash text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN CASE ash
        WHEN 'ash16' THEN 'carre'
        WHEN 'ash20' THEN 'triangle'
        WHEN 'ash24' THEN 'cercle'
        WHEN 'ash30' THEN 'rectangle'
        WHEN 'lot1' THEN 'carre'
        WHEN 'lot2' THEN 'triangle'
        WHEN 'lot3' THEN 'cercle'
        WHEN 'lot4' THEN 'rectangle'
        ELSE 'inconnu'
    END;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_denominations()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    rule_record RECORD;
    combo_record RECORD;
    next_alpha CHAR(1);
    counter INT;
BEGIN
    -- Parcourir toutes les règles de dénomination
    FOR rule_record IN 
        SELECT 
            dr.*,
            d.full_name,
            d.denomination_id
        FROM denomination_rules dr
        JOIN denominations d ON dr.denomination_id = d.denomination_id
    LOOP
        counter := 0;
        
        -- Pour chaque règle, trouver les combinaisons non encore affectées
        FOR combo_record IN (
            SELECT c.combination_id
            FROM combinations c
            LEFT JOIN combination_denominations cd ON c.combination_id = cd.combination_id
            WHERE cd.combination_id IS NULL  -- Seulement les non affectées
              AND c.univers = rule_record.univers
              AND c.forme = rule_record.forme
              AND c.engine = rule_record.engine
              AND c.beastie = rule_record.beastie
              AND c.granque_name = rule_record.granque_name
            ORDER BY c.num1, c.num2
        ) LOOP
            next_alpha := CHR(97 + counter);
            
            -- Insérer dans combination_denominations
            INSERT INTO combination_denominations (
                combination_id,
                denomination_id,
                alpha_code
            ) VALUES (
                combo_record.combination_id,  -- Accès via le record
                rule_record.denomination_id,
                next_alpha
            ) ON CONFLICT (combination_id) DO NOTHING;
            
            -- Mettre à jour la colonne denomination
            UPDATE combinations
            SET denomination = rule_record.full_name
            WHERE combination_id = combo_record.combination_id;
            
            counter := counter + 1;
        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_combinations(p_base_name character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_index_number integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_univers character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(combination_id integer, combinaison text, full_name text, denomination_row_number integer, details text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        c.combination_id,
        c.num1 || '-' || c.num2 AS combinaison,
        nd.full_name,
        c.denomination_row_number,
        'Engine: ' || c.engine || ', Beastie: ' || c.beastie AS details
    FROM 
        combinations c
        JOIN numbered_denominations nd ON c.denomination_id = nd.denomination_id
    WHERE 
        (p_base_name IS NULL OR nd.base_name = p_base_name)
        AND (p_index_number IS NULL OR nd.index_number = p_index_number)
        AND (p_univers IS NULL OR c.univers = p_univers)
    ORDER BY 
        nd.base_name, 
        nd.index_number, 
        c.denomination_row_number;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_denomination(p_base_name character varying, p_univers character varying, p_forme character varying, p_engine character varying, p_beastie character varying, p_granque character varying)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_denomination_id INTEGER;
    v_next_index INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- S'assurer que le nom de base existe
    INSERT INTO base_denominations (base_name)
    VALUES (p_base_name)
    ON CONFLICT (base_name) DO NOTHING;
    
    -- Trouver ou créer la dénomination numérotée
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(index_number), 0) + 1 INTO v_next_index
    FROM numbered_denominations
    WHERE base_name = p_base_name;
    
    INSERT INTO numbered_denominations (base_name, index_number)
    VALUES (p_base_name, v_next_index)
    ON CONFLICT (base_name, index_number) 
    DO UPDATE SET base_name = EXCLUDED.base_name  -- Nécessaire pour le RETURNING
    RETURNING denomination_id INTO v_denomination_id;
    
    -- Mettre à jour les combinaisons correspondantes
    WITH matching_combinations AS (
        SELECT combination_id
        FROM combinations
        WHERE univers = p_univers
          AND forme = p_forme
          AND engine = p_engine
          AND beastie = p_beastie
          AND granque_name = p_granque
          AND denomination_id IS NULL
        ORDER BY num1::text, num2::text
    ),
    numbered_matches AS (
        SELECT 
            combination_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS row_num
        FROM matching_combinations
    )
    UPDATE combinations c
    SET 
        denomination_id = v_denomination_id,
        denomination_row_number = nm.row_num
    FROM numbered_matches nm
    WHERE c.combination_id = nm.combination_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_sync_unidos()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.col_num1 IS NOT NULL AND NEW.col_num2 IS NOT NULL THEN
        NEW.unidos_id := (
            SELECT unidos_id FROM unidos 
            WHERE 
                (NEW.col_num1 = 'col1' AND NEW.col_num2 = 'col1' AND unidos = 'unos') OR
                ((NEW.col_num1 = 'col1' AND NEW.col_num2 = 'col2' OR 
                  NEW.col_num1 = 'col2' AND NEW.col_num2 = 'col1') AND unidos = 'un_dos') OR
                (NEW.col_num1 = 'col2' AND NEW.col_num2 = 'col2' AND unidos = 'dos') OR
                (NEW.col_num1 NOT IN ('col1','col2') OR NEW.col_num2 NOT IN ('col1','col2')) AND unidos = 'autre'
        );
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.determine_granque(engine_val text, beastie_val text)
 RETURNS character varying
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN CASE 
        WHEN engine_val IN ('train', 'car', 'bus', 'helicoptere', 'ship') THEN
            CASE
                WHEN beastie_val IN ('lion', 'cow', 'goat', 'cock', 'tiger') THEN 'Q1'  -- 'tigre' remplacé par 'tiger'
                WHEN beastie_val IN ('eagle', 'dog', 'scorpion', 'cat', 'elephant') THEN 'Q2'
                WHEN beastie_val IN ('horse', 'tortoise', 'crocodile', 'zebra', 'viper') THEN 'Q3'
                ELSE NULL
            END
        WHEN engine_val IN ('plane', 'ambulance', 'pompier', 'bulldozer', 'titan') THEN
            CASE
                WHEN beastie_val IN ('lion', 'cow', 'goat', 'cock', 'tiger') THEN 'Q4'  -- Correction ici aussi
                WHEN beastie_val IN ('eagle', 'dog', 'scorpion', 'cat', 'elephant') THEN 'Q5'
                WHEN beastie_val IN ('horse', 'tortoise', 'crocodile', 'zebra', 'viper') THEN 'Q6'
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ELSE NULL
    END;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_tomes_all_univers_final_v7()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    univers_list TEXT[] := ARRAY['mundo', 'fruity', 'trigga', 'roaster', 'sunshine'];
    current_univers TEXT;
    processed_count INTEGER := 0;
    total_processed INTEGER := 0;
    error_count INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
    RAISE NOTICE 'Début du calcul des tomes pour tous les univers...';
    
    -- S'assurer que toutes les valeurs de tome existent
    INSERT INTO tomes (tome_name) VALUES 
        ('tome1'),
        ('tome2'), 
        ('tome3'),
        ('update')
    ON CONFLICT (tome_name) DO NOTHING;
    
    FOREACH current_univers IN ARRAY univers_list LOOP
        BEGIN
            RAISE NOTICE 'Traitement de l''univers : %', current_univers;
            
            -- Calculer et mettre à jour les tomes
            UPDATE combinations c
            SET tome = calc.tome_attributed
            FROM (
                -- Première CTE : calculer les statistiques par dénomination
                WITH chip_denominations AS (
                    SELECT 
                        c2.chip,
                        nd.full_name AS denomination,
                        MAX(get_granque_value(c2.granque_name)) AS granque_value,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT c2.combination_id) AS combination_count
                    FROM 
                        combinations c2
                        JOIN numbered_denominations nd ON c2.denomination_id = nd.denomination_id
                    WHERE 
                        c2.univers = current_univers
                        AND c2.denomination_id IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY 
                        c2.chip, nd.full_name
                ),
                -- Deuxième CTE : agréger par chip
                chip_totals AS (
                    SELECT 
                        chip,
                        SUM(granque_value) AS total_granque,
                        SUM(combination_count) AS total_combinations
                    FROM 
                        chip_denominations
                    GROUP BY 
                        chip
                ),
                -- Troisième CTE : calculer le tome final
                chip_final AS (
                    SELECT 
                        chip,
                        total_granque + total_combinations AS sigma_chip,
                        determine_tome((total_granque + total_combinations)::NUMERIC) AS tome_attributed
                    FROM 
                        chip_totals
                )
                SELECT 
                    chip,
                    tome_attributed
                FROM 
                    chip_final
            ) calc
            WHERE c.univers = current_univers
            AND c.chip = calc.chip
            AND c.denomination_id IS NOT NULL;
            
            GET DIAGNOSTICS processed_count = ROW_COUNT;
            total_processed := total_processed + processed_count;
            RAISE NOTICE 'Univers % traité : % lignes mises à jour', current_univers, processed_count;
            
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            error_count := error_count + 1;
            RAISE WARNING 'Erreur lors du traitement de l''univers % : %', current_univers, SQLERRM;
        END;
    END LOOP;
    
    RAISE NOTICE 'Calcul terminé : % univers traités, % erreurs, % lignes mises à jour', 
                 array_length(univers_list, 1) - error_count, error_count, total_processed;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.maintain_numbering()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    current_trigger_name TEXT := TG_NAME;
    running_flag BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    -- Vérifier si le déclencheur est déjà en cours d'exécution
    SELECT is_running INTO running_flag
    FROM trigger_running
    WHERE trigger_name = current_trigger_name;

    IF running_flag IS TRUE THEN
        -- Si le déclencheur est déjà en cours d'exécution, ne rien faire pour éviter la récursion
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Définir l'état du déclencheur à en cours d'exécution
    UPDATE trigger_running
    SET is_running = TRUE
    WHERE trigger_name = current_trigger_name;

    -- Votre logique de mise à jour des numéros de rang ici
    -- Par exemple, réinitialiser les numéros de rang pour la nouvelle combinaison
    UPDATE combinations
    SET denomination_row_number = NULL
    WHERE univers = NEW.univers
    AND forme = NEW.forme
    AND denomination = NEW.denomination;

    -- Réinitialiser l'état du déclencheur
    UPDATE trigger_running
    SET is_running = FALSE
    WHERE trigger_name = current_trigger_name;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
